title: feat(list): a phone list gets its own top row, one row of pills, and bottom-sheet sort, filter and view panels that apply on ✓
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3cWtmKPZ5QYDKwmF13UfAe)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXQEtN6Kp1wRKH6Fde

Fixes #35883
Fixes #35884

Clause-②: yes (widening): new optional props `SortBuilder.layout` / `onAddLevel` / `onChangeLevelField` (`@object-ui/components`); new optional `BulkActionBar.open` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`); new exports `PhonePanelSheet`, `useListPhonePanels`, `PHONE_CHIP`, `PHONE_CHIP_ACTIVE` (+ types `PhonePanelSheetProps`, `ListPhonePanels`) from `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `requestListSelection`, `useListPageSelecting`, `useListPageSelectable` from `@object-ui/plugin-grid`; new keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` locale (`listConditions.phone.*`, `sortBuilder.levelOptions` / `.changeField`, `console.objectView.select`); nothing removed or renamed. (`FilterPanel.advancedOffered` is internal to plugin-list: `FilterPanel` is not a package export.)
Metadata-protocol: none
Flow: card thread builds itself (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z rule); both cards are p1/p2 children of epic #35880 (Sales 2026-11-20 16:41Z), one PR as the seat dispatched them.

## 维护者速读
- 手机上打开对象列表（例如「客户」），顶部一行变成：返回、对象图标和名字、「⋮ 更多」；通知和头像不在这一行。
- 下面一行全是胶囊按钮：视图名加条数、排序、筛选、搜索。有排序或筛选时按钮上带数字并高亮。手机上不再单独占一行显示排序筛选标签。
- 点排序、筛选、视图名，都从底部弹出面板。排序和筛选面板里改的是一份副本：点「✓」才生效，点「×」或下滑就丢掉。生效时走的是电脑端同一个写入，没有第二条保存路径。
- 排序面板每一级两行（字段在上、方向在下），可以用手指按住把手拖动排顺序；每级有「⋯」菜单（换字段、升降序、删除）。筛选面板列出每个条件；没有条件时是一句说明加「添加筛选」。视图用的是「或」组合这类高级筛选时，面板只提示「请在电脑上修改」。
- 「视图设置」进了视图名面板的最后一项，打开后内容和电脑端一样。
- 面板里弹出屏幕键盘时，面板会缩到键盘上方，「✓」和正在输入的框都不会被挡。没改任何东西就点「✓」，不会写入。
- 长按一张卡片进入选中状态，这张被选中；「⋮ 更多」里的「选择」也能进入。「选择」只在能多选的卡片列表上出现，看板、日历、不可选或只能单选的列表上不显示。选中时点卡片是加选或取消，右下角「+」隐藏；取消到一张不剩就退出。
- 选中时用的是 #35678（已合并）的底部浮动操作条：「已选 N 条」、×、操作；从「选择」进来还没勾卡片时显示「已选 0 条 ×」，点 × 就退出。选中期间右下角「+」不显示，不会压住操作条。
- 工具行右边的「保存」按钮和它的菜单（保存、放弃、另存先起名、保存后的提示、临时视图设置）由 #35955 提供（席位在 #35883 评论 7061423282、#35884 评论 7061428301 记下了这一分工；这里已经留好位置，#35955 的 PR #36026 合并后会自动出现）。
- 出错时用户在手机上会看到旧的工具行消失但新面板打不开；改动只在界面上，撤回这个 PR 就恢复原样，不动任何已存数据。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

Below `sm` (`useBelowSm`, `(max-width: 639.98px)`) the object list keeps its desktop content and changes only its containers (ruling record 7045325067 on #35880).

**The page's top row** (app-shell `layout/PhonePageBar.tsx`, new): a page publishes `{ icon, title, end }` into a small store `ConsoleLayout` mounts; `AppHeader` draws it in place of the app pill, the phone title, the search, the bell, the assistant/help group and the avatar while the page is on screen (phone only, never on a phone tab page). `ObjectView` publishes 「‹ · object colour tile (`ObjectIconTile`, as #36042 draws it on desktop) · object name · ⋮ More」. ⋮ More is `ObjectViewMoreMenu` (extracted from `ObjectViewPageBarActions`, which now uses it), with 「Select」 first.

**One row of pills** (`PhoneListToolbar`, plugin-list `phone/PhoneListPanels.tsx`): the host's `toolbarLeading` (the view switcher's phone face: the view's name, its count, the caret), Sort N, Filter N, the list's search (now a 44 px pill), then the host's `conditionRowEnd`. The desktop toolbar row and the condition row are not drawn below `sm`. A count highlights its pill; with none the pill is the icon alone. `userActions.sort/filter/search: false` withhold their pills, as on desktop.

**Bottom sheets** (`PhonePanelSheet`, a vaul `Drawer`, full height less 40 px, swipe-down closes): header 「× · title · ✓」 or 「‹」 on a sub-step. `100dvh` does not shrink for the on-screen keyboard (iOS Safari; Chrome on Android's default `resizes-visual`), so the sheet reads `visualViewport` (`useKeyboardInset`): while the keyboard is up its bottom is the keyboard's top and its height is the visible area's less the 40 px strip, so 「✓」 and the focused field stay in view; vaul's own `repositionInputs`, which would also write the height, is off. 「✓」 on an untouched copy writes nothing.
- **Sort**: the levels in `SortBuilder`'s new `layout="stacked"`; 「Add sort」 and 「Change field」 step to `FieldList`. The sheet edits a copy (`useStaged`) and 「✓」 hands it to `applySort`, the write the desktop sort chip calls (which ends in `onSortChange`); 「×」 drops it.
- **Filter**: the conditions with a ⋯ menu (edit, remove); 「Add filter」 and edit step through `FilterPanel` (`advancedOffered={false}`). 「✓」 hands the copy to `applyPanelFilters`, the desktop chips' write. A filter that is not a flat AND of conditions (an `or` group, nesting) shows 「This view uses an advanced filter. Change it on a computer.」 and edits nothing.
- **Views**: `ObjectViewSwitcherMenu` with `phone` (search at the bottom, no list height cap) and its footer's last row 「View settings」, which opens…
- **View settings**: `ViewSettingsContent` with the desktop popover's own props; it applies each change as on desktop, so it has 「×」 only.

**SortBuilder** (`@object-ui/components`): touch reorder on the handle in both layouts (pointer events; HTML5 drag does not fire on touch), with the handle `touch-none` and `data-vaul-no-drag` so a drag inside a sheet does not close it. New `layout`, `onAddLevel`, `onChangeLevelField`.

**Card selection** (`ObjectGrid` card renderer, plugin-grid `listPageScope.ts`): a 500 ms long press held within 10 px starts selecting with that card ticked, and the click that ends the press is swallowed; while selecting a tap ticks or unticks, unticking the last ends it; `requestListSelection(pageColumn)` (the More menu's 「Select」) starts it with none ticked. The selection is the grid's one `selectedRows`, shown in #35678's floating `BulkActionBar`; its new optional `open` keeps the bar up at 0 (「0 selected ×」, no actions) while a selection opened by 「Select」 has nothing ticked, and draws nothing new for any other host. The 「Select」 request, the "is a selection open" read and the "would 「Select」 open one" read live in `listPageScope.ts` (`requestListSelection`, `usePublishListSelecting` / `useListPageSelecting`, `usePublishListSelectable` / `useListPageSelectable`); the page hides its 「+」 FAB while one is open, and draws 「Select」 only while the grid says a request would open one (cards whose rows take more than one tick; not a kanban, a calendar, or a list with no or single selection). The grid's `selectionAvailable` in the action context is not enough for that: it is also true for a single-select list, where 「Select」 does nothing. The card scroller carries the grid's root ref, so the cards are inside the list page's scope too. A card is a keyboard control (`role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}`, Enter / Space on its own key, `aria-pressed` while selecting): Enter opens it, and while selecting Enter or Space toggles it. Every pointer-down clears the long press's swallow flag first, so a long press the browser ends with no click (a finger that slid off, Android after its context menu) never eats the next tap.

## Shared with desktop

| Phone part | Shared component | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Sort sheet levels | `SortBuilder` | new `layout="stacked"`; same value/onChange |
| Sort sheet 「Add sort」 / 「Change field」 | `SortPanel`, `FieldList` | unchanged |
| Sort ✓ | `applySort` → `onSortChange` | the desktop chip's write |
| Filter sheet add / edit | `FilterPanel` | `advancedOffered={false}` (internal prop) only drops its footer link |
| Filter ✓ | `applyPanelFilters` → `onFilterChange` | the desktop chips' write |
| Views sheet | `ObjectViewSwitcherMenu` | `phone` moves the search last; `footerEnd` adds View settings |
| View settings sheet | `ViewSettingsContent` | the popover's own props, spread |
| ⋮ More | `ObjectViewMoreMenu` | extracted from the desktop's `ObjectViewPageBarActions` |
| Save (from #35955) | the host's `conditionRowEnd` | drawn at the pill row's end |
| Selection bar | `BulkActionBar` (#35678) | `open` added for an empty open selection |

Separate, and why:
- `PhoneListToolbar`: the desktop bar is two rows of mixed controls; the phone row is pills only, by the card.
- `PhonePanelSheet` and the staging copy (`useStaged`): the container and the 「✓」 layer the ruling asks for. It keeps a copy and nothing else.
- `PhonePageBar`: the app bar has no slot a page fills on desktop, and the desktop draws the object name in the view bar.
- The filter sheet's list of conditions: on desktop each condition is a chip in the condition row, which the phone does not draw.

## Scope with #35955

#35883's Save, discard, save-as (name first), the toast after saving, and the temporary-view-settings rows move to #35955 (seat comment 7061423282 on #35883, 7061428301 on #35884): #36026 draws 「Save ▾」 at the phone pill row's end through the host's `conditionRowEnd`. Until it lands, `conditionRowEnd` draws today's 「Personalized · Reset」 there.

## Follow-ups

- A tap on a card's link cell (a URL or lookup link) while selecting opens the link instead of ticking the card: the cell stops the click from reaching the card (objectstack#33548's rule). The seat opens a small card.
- Not taken from the L2 nits: the filter count counts top-level entries (a nested group counts as one); a card stays a focusable `role="button"` even on a list whose rows open nothing and take no tick.

## Overlap

`overlap-check.mjs` against main and open PRs: clean. #36021 (#35678) landed first, as the seat ordered; main is merged here (c884e47f, again at 6aef25ae): `listPageBarSlot.ts` and `SelectionPageBar` are gone, and the cards' selection is #36021's bar.

## Verification

- Unit, on f6a0264d (the L1-b round, main 1647fb3d merged at 6aef25ae, full `pnpm build`): grid + list 481 files / 4,607 tests; the app-shell subset 137 files / 1,225 tests; type-check of plugin-grid, plugin-list, app-shell and components, eslint (0 errors), `check:test-source-alias`, `check:i18n-keys` and overlap-check (main and 6 open PRs) clean.
- Unit, on 7bea6cb0 (the L2 round): `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid packages/plugin-list` passes, 481 files and 4,602 tests; app-shell, the 137 files that import `ObjectView`, the phone page bar, the title switcher or the selection reads pass, 1,224 tests; type-check of plugin-grid, plugin-list and app-shell, eslint on the changed files (0 errors), `check:test-source-alias`, `check:i18n-keys` and overlap-check (main and 7 open PRs) are clean.
- Unit, after the merge: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid packages/plugin-list packages/i18n` plus the click census pass, 587 files and 6,559 tests. app-shell: the 160 files that import or drive the changed modules (the switcher, the switcher menu, the page header, `AppHeader`, `ObjectView`, the FAB, the selection bar, the phone viewport) pass, 1,259 tests. The whole package (2,357 files) is left to CI's shards.
- New tests:
  - `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.phonePanels-35884.test.tsx` (11): the pill row and no condition row; `userActions.sort: false`; sort 「✓」 writes once through `onSortChange` and the count turns 1; 「×」 writes nothing and the sheet reopens from the list's sort; the empty filter state; the `or` group notice; an untouched 「✓」 writes nothing (sort, and the advanced-filter notice); with a stand-in `visualViewport` 300 px short the sheet's bottom is 300 px and its height the visible area less 40 px, and both clear when it grows back (ablated: fails without the inset style); `SortBuilder` stacked rows; touch reorder.
  - `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/cardSelection-35883.test.tsx` (8): a long press with no click after it, then one tap on another card ticks that card (ablated: fails with the flag reset after the early return); 「Select」 is offered (`useListPageSelectable`) for `multiple` and not for `single` or `none` (ablated: fails when it follows `rowsSelectable`); long press ticks and opens nothing, a tap adds, unticking the last ends; a press that moves starts nothing; 「Select」 starts with none ticked and the bar reads 0 with 「×」 alone, which ends it; a long press floats the bar after the cards reading 1; Enter opens a card and Space toggles it while selecting; no selection without `selection`.
- Rewritten tests:
  - `ListView.phoneSortSearch-28911`: the phone search trigger's size is now the pill's `h-11 min-w-11`.
  - `ListView.phoneWidth-29074`: the same for the phone search trigger; the Display trigger's assertion is unchanged.
  - e2e `list-toolbar-view-name-phone` (#33833's pin): re-pointed from the retired phone toolbar row at the pill row. At 375 and 390, 「全部客户」 and 「All Customers」 are whole on one row with three 44 px pills. At 320, 「全部客户」 is whole and a longer name truncates while the pills stay on screen. A viewport meta is added so the mobile projects lay out at the viewport's width. `tagClass` also reads `cn(CONSTANT, '…')`.
  - `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.phoneFabSelecting-35883.test.tsx` (3): the phone 「+」 is drawn, is not drawn while a list publishes an open selection, and is drawn again after; ⋮ More has no 「Select」 until the list publishes that one would open, then has it (ablated: the old `titleSwitcher` gate fails the first).
  - `components/src/__tests__/clickableNonControlCensus-13461`: the mobile card list's BACKLOG row is deleted. The card is repaired (a control with `role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}`, Enter / Space on its own key, `aria-pressed` while selecting), as the backlog's deletions-only rule asks; `cardSelection-35883` pins the keyboard path.
  - i18n: `listConditions.phone.sortCount` / `.filterCount` are count families with every CLDR slot their pack selects and a base key (objectui#11445), in all packs and the English fallbacks.
  - e2e `list-frame-geometry-35548`: the switcher's source-order check reads the desktop trigger inside `<PopoverTrigger>`, since the phone pill comes first in the file and draws no type icon.
- e2e, chromium, run locally: `list-toolbar-view-name-phone` (both chromium projects), `list-frame-geometry-35548`, `list-condition-row-35549`, `list-no-actions-column-35554`, `list-left-edge-35663` and `list-header-narrow-35446` all pass; after the merge every `e2e/list-*` spec passes (50).
- Browser, own backend and console, CRM 「客户」 list, 375 and 390, light and dark: the top row, the pill row, the sort, filter and views sheets, ⋮ More, and a long press into selection. After the merge, at 375 light and dark: 「Select」 with none ticked (「0 selected ×」), two ticked (「2 selected × Delete」), the 「+」 gone. Screenshots went to the seat.
- Keyboard, SIMULATED in Chromium at 375, light and dark (`window.visualViewport` replaced by a stand-in 336 px shorter, a grey block drawn where a keyboard would be): the filter value step with its field focused and the views sheet with its search focused. Both sheets read `data-keyboard-inset=336`, span y 40–476 (the keyboard's top), with 「✓」 at y 73–117 and the focused field above 476 (the filter value at 172–204, the views search at 355–400). Not a real device reading. 「Select」 checked in the same console: offered on the CRM 「客户」 list and opens the bar.
